message.content: {"reason": "The current pipeline feeds arbitrary integer codes for categoricals into both the GBDT matrix and (indirectly) the blend, which imposes false ordering on fields like coupon, occupation, and income that directly drive acceptance; validation accuracy 0.7443 is limited mainly by this representational mismatch, matching the supervisor note about weak target encoding. The fix must live in feature engineering (leakage-free smoothed target encoding) and training/evaluation wiring (OOF construction, bundle persistence, read-only reload), while leaving the NN architecture, fold split, and blend procedure untouched as the initial plan requires.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Add a smoothed target encoder to CouponFeatureEngineer (or a sibling class persisted in the bundle) that converts the schema categorical columns (coupon, occupation, education, income, age, maritalStatus, gender) and the frequency categorical columns (Bar, CoffeeHouse, CarryAway, RestaurantLessThan20, Restaurant20To50) into shrunk acceptance statistics, using encoded = (sum_y + prior*m)/(count + m) with m=20 and a global prior over training labels. WHY: these low-cardinality fields (5-25 levels) carry strong coupon-acceptance signal but are currently fed as arbitrary integer codes; tree splits on meaningless thresholds cannot isolate the high- vs low-acceptance categories, and the NN only gets this signal indirectly through embeddings. HOW: extend CouponFeatureEngineer with fit_target_encoding(df, y, fold_ids, m=20) that (a) builds category->encoding maps per column from training rows only, (b) produces out-of-fold encodings for each row using the existing stratified 5-fold split (seed 7, folds defined by training loop) so a row's own label never contributes to its encoding, and (c) exposes transform_target_encoding(df) that applies the saved maps with unseen/NaN categories falling back to the stored global prior. Store the maps, prior, m, te_col_names in the engineer so they serialize with it, and keep existing feature_names/reindex/NaN-fill behavior intact; for the GBDT matrix produced by _prepare_gbdt_matrix, replace each raw integer categorical column with its target-encoded value (keep numeric columns untouched), and expose the encoded values as an extra numeric block for _prepare_fold so the NN can append them as additional numeric inputs without changing embedding cards. Preserve function names _prepare_fold, _prepare_gbdt_matrix, and the feature_names ordering contract.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Wire the leakage-free target encoding into the existing fold loop, full-data fit, bundle persistence, and prediction reload without changing the stratified 5-fold split (seed 7), model seeds, NN architecture, GBDT configs, blend-alpha search, or output format. WHY: the encoded features are only useful if training rows see out-of-fold encodings while final models and prediction use full-training-fit maps loaded read-only; historical successful runs show that persisting all fitted state (maps, prior, feature order, categorical metadata) in the bundle and reusing it unchanged at inference is what prevents silent leakage and fresh-process failures. HOW: in run_train, compute fold_ids exactly as now, call the engineer's fit_target_encoding(features, y, fold_ids) before building fold matrices so each training fold uses encodings derived from that fold's training rows only and validation rows use the same maps for validation-time features; after OOF/blend evaluation, refit target-encoding maps on all training rows for the full-model fit and the GBDT full ensemble. Extend _save_bundle to persist the target-encoder state (maps, global prior, m, te_col_names) and any expanded feature_names/cat_cols/num_cols ordering, keeping the nn_cfg, gbdt_models, blend_alpha, and label_map keys. In run_predict, load the bundle, apply transform_target_encoding via the saved maps only (never refit), fall back to the stored prior for unseen categories, and rebuild the NN numeric matrix with the appended TE block and the GBDT matrix with TE replacing integer categories, preserving row_id = 0..N-1 and original-label output."}}

We need to output JSON only. Modules: data_processing_and_feature_engineering, training_evaluation (and maybe model_design for appending target-encoded numerics to NN). The core is target encoding, leakage-safe OOF. Historic successes: CatBoost native categorical, OOF threshold tuning persisted. Initial plan says keep architecture unchanged aside from appending TE numeric. Let's pick two modules: data_processing_and_feature_engineering and training_evaluation. Maybe include model_design to note NN extra numeric inputs? Cards unchanged. But appending TE features as numeric to NN requires n_num change, but no architecture change. I'd include data_processing_and_feature_engineering and training_evaluation (OOF construction, save maps in bundle). Possibly model_design third for GBDT matrix replacing raw integer columns with TE values and NN inputs — but that's within preprocessing. Keep 2 modules to be concise.

Write plans referencing existing names: CouponFeatureEngineer, _prepare_fold, _prepare_gbdt_matrix, _save_bundle, run_predict, folds seed 7, bundle keys.

Plan for data_processing: add a smoothed target encoder class (TargetEncoder) with fit_transform_oof using fold assignments seed 7; m=20; fit on training rows only; persist maps/prior. Produce target-encoded columns for CAT_COLS_RAW plus frequency columns (Bar..Restaurant20To50 as keys? treat raw string categories). For GBDT matrix replace integer category columns with TE; for NN append TE numerics. Unseen -> prior. Preserve feature_names ordering, reindex behavior, NaN handling.

Through OOF: need fold ids computed identically to training loop. To avoid circular, compute folds in run_train (as currently) and pass to encoder. But data_processing module can't own run_train... plan says implement helper `build_oof_target_encoding(frames, y, folds, cols, m=20)` in preprocessing, invoked from run_train; training_evaluation owns fold creation and bundle persistence. Keep concise.

Training_evaluation: build folds deterministic (already exists), pass tr/val masks; use OOF TE for training rows, full-fit maps for final/full and for prediction; persist encoder state in bundle ("target_encoder", "te_cols") via _save_bundle; load in run_predict without refit; unseen fallback prior. Also note avoiding leakage: encodings for val rows in each fold computed from that fold's train rows only; final full models use encodings fit on all training rows.
